title: International Postdoctoral Fellowship Program
about: The Ocean Frontier Institute International Postdoctoral Fellowship Program lists positions at Dalhousie University and UQAR in Canada, with applications listed until February 28, 2027 and award announcements expected in May 2027. One OFI overview page lists the programme as closed, so confirm the current call.
requirements: Completed application package with supporting documents sent to the Training and Early Career Development Program Manager at Dalhousie by the deadline
Referees submit confidential reference forms directly before the deadline

upskill.name: AI for Research & Academic Productivity
why: requirement "Completed application package with supporting documents" -> objective "Improve academic workflows involving writing support, data exploration, note organization, document analysis, and research knowledge management"

seniority "Postdoctoral" in field "Ocean and climate research" -> objective "Use AI to support literature exploration, academic reading, information organization, research planning, and knowledge synthesis"
